items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: We were recently in Iowa and Leisl [Sagartz] and I went ahead of time to adjudicate a high school festival

ctx.x: Oh when you go to these high school competitions now, it’s very common to see more girl saxophone players than guys in the sections. My own daughter plays trumpet. She’s not by herself back there all the time either.

We were recently in Iowa and Leisl [Sagartz] and I went ahead of time to adjudicate a high school festival, there was like twenty bands. Most of them were girls, like in every band, almost every, like one band had one boy playing tenor, all girls.
